label: late original phase / <DEL> step when the sequence began with a, y, d, 0, c, q or s
explanation: Fires only at steps t=5..9 in the original phase or on the <DEL> step (65% of mass on <DEL>), never in the copy phase and never before t=4. Whether it fires depends on how the sequence started: the first original token, and to a lesser extent the second, comes from {a, y, d, 0, c, q, s}. This looks like a late readout of the first token(s), which the model will need to output at the <DEL> step (out_tok in that set gives 4-6x lift). The strongest activations are on <DEL> when both of the first two tokens are in the set. In the original phase it favours first occurrences of tokens and inputs o/z. Firing depends on the first two tokens in a graded, distributed way, so the predicate has only about 40% precision and recall (it captures about half the mass). It does not fire on repeated inputs or on short sequences (L<=4).
